description: Router, one in and eight out — the input to each output through its own attenuverter

params.text: An attenuverter, -1 to +1, over how much of the input reaches that output; it starts at zero, so nothing passes until it is turned up

inputs.text: The signal fed to all eight attenuverters

outputs.text: The input scaled by that output's own knob, soft clipped at 12V; hard clipping or none on the menu

notes: the knobs are attenuverters and start at zero, so nothing reaches any output until some are turned up
menu: Output clipping — Soft/saturated (better for audio) rounds the output off at 12V, Hard/clipped (better for CV) cuts it there and so sums CVs exactly, and None leaves it uncapped
Indicator knobs — colours each knob green or orange to show its setting
Unipolar — each knob runs from zero to full over its whole travel and can no longer invert; the tick at noon then marks 50%
